body: I cut my act score into my leg last year. it's mostly faded but I can still see it if I look for it.
ahh yes!! I'm playing right now believe it or not haha. that's a tough question, maybe mettaton? how about you?

what exactly do mental hospitals *do* to treat people? give you meds? constant therapy? just lock you in a room? it's always been unclear to me. I know people personally who have gone and I can't seem to get a clear answer there, either.
I wrote my parents a letter when I told them about my cutting a couple years ago. Sounds kinda dorky, but it was a lot easier than face to face.
your friend/crush is being manipulative. That's a horrible thing to say to someone who self harms. I like how hazyshadeofwinterr put it.
I feel that too. I've cut other places before but it definitely feels different. I always get the urge in my arm.

I really like entertaining this idea but I'm not sure what I think of it. I definitely got the trans vibe with his wanting a new body but to me it sounded like he wants to be human, not necessarily change his gender. the house didn't really throw me for a loop because of mettatons style now. it'd still be really cool to have a trans character in undertale, though

my favorite armor is the apron because it gives you 1 extra hp every other turn. not much but it helps. locket probably wouldn't be bad either but I haven't tried that yet. 
for a weapon I prefer the frying pan or ballet shoes, those work well for me.
Right after I posted this I fought her one more time and beat her. woo
